name: TrueSignal beacon located outside the expected countries
description: A known beacon fired from outside the expected countries. The location is trusted only when it describes the client: an EDNS client subnet (truesignal.source_geo.basis: client_subnet) or the source address of an HTTP beacon. A DNS beacon located by its source is the resolver, so it is never used here. Ships disabled: set the expected-country list first.
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: Travelling staff, VPN or cloud egress in another country, privacy relays (iCloud Private Relay, corporate SASE) that hide the client's country.
note:
## Before enabling
Replace the country list in the query (`EG` is a placeholder) with every country your staff, VPN egress and cloud regions legitimately use. [NOT IN PROJECT]

## Triage
1. This always accompanies truesignal-beacon-triggered for the same event; triage that alert and use this one as context.
2. `truesignal.source_geo.address` is the address that was located (the subnet network for `client_subnet`).
query: event.dataset:"truesignal.alert" and event.action:"beacon_triggered" and truesignal.details.beacon.id:* and (truesignal.source_geo.basis:"client_subnet" or (truesignal.source_geo.basis:"source" and truesignal.details.channel:"http")) and not truesignal.source_geo.countryCode:("EG")
